topic: Compare prices of shampoo bottles along with their volume over the years
kindReason: The topic sets several shampoo bottles side by side, so the output compares each option's price and volume rather than estimating one purchase or projecting future prices.
title: Shampoo bottle prices and volume over the years (Singapore)
summary: Covers the SGD shelf price and volume in ml of popular shampoo bottles sold in Singapore, compared on price per 100 ml across recent years. Key assumptions: prices come from major Singapore retailers, sizes are the bottle sizes currently on sale, and past prices are used only where a source records them.
